name: current_bus_arrival
viewDefinition:
WITH latest_successful_run AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (poll_run.scope_key) poll_run.id,
            poll_run.scope_key
           FROM ingestion.poll_run
          WHERE poll_run.outcome::text = ANY (ARRAY['SUCCESS'::character varying, 'PARTIAL'::character varying]::text[])
          ORDER BY poll_run.scope_key, poll_run.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST, poll_run.started_at DESC
        )
 SELECT observation.id,
    observation.raw_observation_id,
    observation.poll_run_id,
    observation.reference_version_id,
    observation.stop_code,
    observation.service_id,
    observation.operator,
    observation.direction_id,
    observation.visit_order,
    observation.estimated_arrival_at,
    observation.latitude,
    observation.longitude,
    observation.load_category,
    observation.feature,
    observation.fetched_at,
    observation.ingested_at,
    observation.record_checksum,
    observation.origin_code,
    observation.destination_code,
    observation.monitored,
    observation.vehicle_type,
    observation.classification,
    observation.demo_run_id,
    observation.trip_id,
    observation.visit_number,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - observation.fetched_at)::bigint AS age_seconds
   FROM latest_successful_run run
     JOIN ingestion.bus_arrival_observation observation ON observation.poll_run_id = run.id
  WHERE observation.classification::text = 'OBSERVATION_ONLY'::text;
